data.title: Bitcoin rebounds to $76,000, but $1.3 billion ETF exodus tests recovery
data.description: Investing.com -- Bitcoin was trading above $76,000 on Saturday, showing signs of stabilization after a bruising selloff, but another wave of withdrawals from U.S. exchange-traded funds highlighted the gap between its modest recovery and institutional demand.
